final: WITH j AS (SELECT o.timespan AS ts, f.rebrate AS rb, f.feerate AS fr FROM fees f JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault), g AS (SELECT ts, AVG(rb / fr) AS avg_ratio, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM j GROUP BY ts), a AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_cnt FROM g) SELECT AVG(g.avg_ratio) AS avg_of_avg_ratio, SUM(g.cnt) AS total_cnt, AVG(g.cnt - a.avg_cnt) AS avg_excess FROM g, a WHERE g.cnt > a.avg_cnt
